title: Filipino-Style Zesty Egg Bake
description: A delicious breakfast or brunch dish combining zesty Filipino flavors with eggs baked in a flavorful mixture.
instructions: In a skillet, melt butter over low heat. Add chopped green onions and cook until softened.
In a large bowl, whisk eggs and season with zesty seasoning. Add cooked green onions and stir.
In a greased 9x13-inch baking dish, arrange half of the grated cheddar cheese.
Pour the egg mixture over the cheese and smooth the top.
Sprinkle the remaining cheese on top of the eggs.
Bake for 25-30 minutes, or until eggs are set and the top is golden brown.
Remove from oven and let cool for 5 minutes before serving.
Serve warm, garnished with additional chopped green onions if desired.
